project.title: Metagenomic sequencing of air filters from utility vehicels used in MBT plants in Poland - raw sequence reads
project.description: The aim of study was to assess occupational exposure to bacteria and antimicrobial resistance genes (ARGs) present on air filters of utility vehicles used in the working environment of mechanical-biological treatment (MBT) facilities, in the context of workers health risks.
project.center_name: Institute of Biochemistry and Biophysics Polish Academy of Sciences
